Name: Useful Trophies
Author: BasiliskL
Description:
Trophy: produces a Stardrop monthly

Soda Machine: produces an Iridium Milk monthly (iridium snake milk, currently doesn't actually do anything)

Trophy and Soda Machine can't be sped up with fairy dust.

Also with automate you can make Stardrop Tea from the Stardrop by having a chest with green tea in it next to the trophy and a keg next to that.
Keeps quality of the green tea used so if you are using a mod that let's you get quality green tea it keeps the quality.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Useful Trophies
Manifest.Description: Makes the Trophy or Soda Machine you get from completing the community center actually useful. Also craftable stardrop tea.
Manifest.Author: LordDracon
